# Docparser

Docparser is the most advanced cloud based document parsing and automation tool in the market today.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docparser/.

## Actions

- **Get Multiple Document Results** (read-only): Retrieve parsed data from multiple documents processed by a specific parser.
- **List Parsers** (read-only): Retrieve all Document Parsers linked to your account.
- **Ping API** (read-only): Test API authentication and connection health check for Docparser API.
- **Get Parser Models** (read-only): Retrieve all model layouts for a specific parser.
